d:
A controversy has erupted in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir over the playing of 'Vande Mataram' at an event organized by the Waqf Board. Some clerics who stood up during the national song faced criticism, following which they issued a video statement on Wednesday expressing regret for their actions. The religious leaders stated that they are remorseful for their mistake.
